Kill the [[Eldritch Ettin]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the Eldritch Ettin in the [[Bloodstone Caves]].
* *BONUS* Kill the Eldritch Ettin in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Crystal Method#Walkthrough|Crystal Method walkthrough]].

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Bounty
:''"Kill the Eldritch Ettin in the Bloodstone Caves."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
* This quest was first offered on 13th May 2009
* When doing this quest, walk through the door to the dungeon as this will put you into the dungeon and not the story mode quest; do not interact with the [[Inscription Stone]].
